title: KherveBook: A native desktop computational notebook combining Python, Markdown, LaTeX, spreadsheets and vector drawings

creators.name: Kerhervé, Gwilherm
creators.affiliation: Department of Materials, Imperial College London

description: KherveBook is an open-source, Jupyter-inspired computational notebook implemented as a native Qt desktop application with its own in-process Python kernel. A single document mixes six cell types: runnable Python, Markdown, LaTeX (typeset via tectonic), live spreadsheets two-way linked to Python, SVG drawings, and JavaScript/HTML. It ships ~180 built-in scientific examples, an AI assistant, per-notebook Git version history, and lossless Jupyter .ipynb import/export.
